cards.card_text: A papyrus basket A wooden boat A clay jar
cards.verse_text: But when she could no longer hide him, she got him a papyrus basket and coated it with tar and pitch.
cards.snippet: But when she could no longer hide him, she got him a papyrus basket and coated it with tar and pitch.

cards.card_text: He asks if papyrus grows where there is no marsh, and if reeds flourish without water.
cards.verse_text: Does papyrus grow where there is no marsh?
cards.snippet: Does papyrus grow where there is no marsh?

cards.card_text: He compares them to a runner, to boats of papyrus and to an eagle swooping down on its prey.
cards.verse_text: They sweep by like boats of papyrus, like an eagle swooping down on its prey.
cards.snippet: They sweep by like boats of papyrus, like an eagle swooping down on its prey.

cards.card_text: Grass and reeds and papyrus Cedars and cypresses and pines Myrtles and acacias and palms
cards.verse_text: In the haunt where jackals once lay, there will be grass and reeds and papyrus.
